source.data_source: Schulein, Krogmann, Stanewsky, DLR IB 223-96 A 49 (Oct 1996); skin-friction data re-published in Schulein, AIAA J 44(8) 2006 ('Schulein 2004 (optical)' in SU2 V&V plot legend). Cross-validated against the SU2 V&V case study (Gomes, SU2 7.4.0, SA-neg / SST-2003m on L1=37k / L2=76k / L3=146k quad meshes).
source.freestream: M=5.0, T_inf=68.333 K, p_inf=4006.88 Pa, U_inf=828.58 m/s, Re/L=4.0e7 m^-1, Re_L=2.092e7 (L=0.523 m), wedge angle 10 deg, walls adiabatic per SU2 V&V config (underlying Schulein experiment used Tw=300 K).

mesh_cell_count.description: Total cell count of the SWBLI mesh (full domain incl. wedge side and interior).
mesh_cell_count.T_good_source: SU2 V&V grid family: L1=37k (coarse), L2=76k (medium), L3=146k (fine), all keep y+<1 on the bottom plate. gt anchored at L2; T_good wide enough to admit any of the three published levels.

final_residual_U.description: Final residual of the streamwise momentum equation.
final_residual_U.T_good_source: Hand-set; SU2 V&V config sets CONV_RESIDUAL_MINVAL=-11.5 (i.e. 1e-11.5). 1e-4 is a conservative practical convergence bar across solvers / turbulence models on this geometry.

cf_upstream.description: Local skin-friction coefficient C_f at x=0.320 m, in the undisturbed turbulent boundary layer ahead of the shock interaction.
cf_upstream.T_good_source: Read from SU2 V&V Cf plot (vv-sources/.../cf.png): both the Schulein 2004 optical experimental points and SU2 SA/SST L1-L3 simulations cluster at C_f ~ 0.00100-0.00110 in the upstream plateau x in [0.32, 0.333]. T_good ~20% of gt absorbs upstream-virtual-origin / inlet-BL-thickness ambiguity across solvers.

cf_min.description: Minimum (most negative) C_f along the bottom plate inside the shock-induced separation bubble. If the run does not separate, the agent reports 0; gt is negative so reporting 0 still incurs T_decay penalty.
cf_min.T_good_source: Schulein 2004 experimental optical Cf (SU2 V&V plot) reaches a minimum near -0.0006 at x ~ 0.341 m. SU2 SA-neg / SST-2003m on L3 reach -0.0018 to -0.0019 at the same location; SA-neg-comp recovers ~-0.0017. T_good=0.001 spans the full experiment-to-RANS-model band (most-negative ~ -0.002) without rewarding fully-attached runs (which would land at +0.001 and miss by 0.002).

x_separation.description: Streamwise location (m) of the upstream zero-crossing of C_f on the bottom plate, i.e. separation onset. If no separation, report 0; gt of 0.333 then yields large T_decay penalty.
x_separation.T_good_source: Schulein 2004 optical experimental Cf goes negative at x ~ 0.333 m (first black-square zero-crossing in SU2 V&V plot). SU2 SST L3 separates at x ~ 0.336; SA-neg L3 at x ~ 0.339; SA-neg-comp L3 at x ~ 0.331. T_good=5 mm covers the SST-vs-SA spread and is tight enough to discriminate from a fully-attached run (which has no zero-crossing and reports 0).

separation_length.description: Streamwise extent (m) of the separation bubble = x_reattachment - x_separation, measured between the upstream and downstream zero-crossings of C_f. If no separation, report 0.
separation_length.T_good_source: Schulein 2004 optical Cf (SU2 V&V plot): zero-crossings at x ~ 0.333 m and x ~ 0.348 m, giving L_sep ~ 15 mm. SU2 SST L3 predicts ~21 mm, SA-neg L3 ~22 mm, SA-neg-comp ~17 mm (closer to experiment). T_good=8 mm absorbs the well-known RANS over-prediction of separation extent for this case.

cf_post_shock.description: Local C_f at x=0.400 m, well downstream of reattachment, in the recovered/recovering turbulent boundary layer.
cf_post_shock.T_good_source: Schulein 2004 optical: Cf at x=0.40 m sits near 0.006 (band 0.005-0.0065 in SU2 V&V plot, with measurement scatter). SU2 SA/SST L3 predict 0.0050-0.0053 at the same x. T_good=0.001 spans the experimental scatter and the model-vs-experiment offset.
